author: Damian Curti
geometry: Original dimensionless controls and owned closed anatomy/garment/native animation tools.
limits: Four distinct owned-reference candidates: stocky adult Curupi with pointed ears, dark braids and rough leaf/bark clothing; gaunt ash Gualicho with long mask-like face, twigs, ribs, claws and ragged geometric cloth; human-avian Uritu Orko with beak-like nose, slate/ivory feathers, arm wing-feathers and talons; bony Maip with bird-like skull/beak, long hair, ribs, spikes and long claws. Fixed ornaments/clothes are art only; no shared taxonomy, metric scale, powers, rules, inventory or cultural claims.
